caseName: Johnson v. Laramie County School District No. 1
caseNameFull: Johnson v. Laramie County School District No. 1

opinions.text: Appeal from Sup. Ct. Wyo. Motion to dispense with printing jurisdictional statement granted. Appeal dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.
